For the Petitioner/s : Mr.Brij Nandan Prasad, Advocate  For the Opposite Party/s : Mr.Anant Kumar 1, A.P.P.
 Mr. Ganesh Sharma, Advocate  ======================================================
 CORAM:

ORAL ORDER 2 08-08-2025 Heard learned counsel for the petitioner, the State and the informant.
2. Petitioner seeks regular bail in a case registered for the offence punishable under sections 306,
376 of the Indian Penal Code and section 67 of the I.T. Act.
3.

As per the prosecution case, petitioner entered the house of the informant and on the point of knife, he made physical relation with his wife and clicked obscene pictures and uploaded them on the Social media.
Thereafter, wife of informant committed suicide by consuming pesticide.
4. Learned counsel appearing for the petitioner submits that the petitioner is innocent and has falsely been implicated in this case due to dirty village politics.
Informant is not eye witness of the occurrence.

Petitioner claims clean Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.38379 of 2025(2)
dt.08-08-2025 antecedent.
5. Learned counsel for the State and the informant oppose the prayer for bail.

They submit that there is specific allegation against the petitioner that he entered the house of the informant and on the point of knife, he made physical relation with his wife and clicked obscene pictures and uploaded them on the Social media.
6. Considering the nature and gravity of allegation, prayer for bail of the petitioner is rejected.
